desc: Ideation and approach selection: backward finite-state DP with lexicographic decisions; run-block/DAG/median approaches rejected.
Implement minCostGoodCaption with the corrected O(26n) backward DP, bytearray decisions, first-character selection, reconstruction, and n<3 early return.
Validate with examples, edge cases (n<3, n=3/4/5, n=6 ties), small brute force, and large performance; fix any failures.
